item.title: Mentaiko: Fukuoka's Spicy Cod Roe — Guide
item.description: Mentaiko — spicy marinated pollock (or cod) roe — is one of Fukuoka’s most iconic foods, and the city of Hakata is considered its Japanese home. The roe sacs are cured in a marinade of chilli, and sometimes sake and other seasonings, giving a savoury, salty, gently spicy flavour and a distinctive popping texture from the tiny eggs. It is endlessly versatile: eaten simply with hot rice, grilled, stuffed into rice balls, blended into creamy mentaiko pasta (a Japanese invention), added to toast, and used across the region’s cooking.
